name: Paula Radziszewska (Paula in Scotland)
reason: Health rule: her own site (yogawithpaula.uk, mostly in Polish) presents her rest-focused yin, restorative yoga and yoga nidra as help for chronic fatigue, stress and burnout and as nervous-system regulation, and her Insight Timer bio and most-played tracks centre on anxiety, PTSD and sleep; the work is wellbeing yoga rather than spiritual teaching.
